G3_faithfulness.justification: Selected swap operators force equality of coordinates within each connected component, so equal projections for all target basis vectors is exactly equivalent to connecting all required vertices in the original tree.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though the abstract projection formulation is more elaborate and less natural than the original cabling description.
